title: Principal AI Evaluations Platform Engineer
description: <p>As Microsoft continues to push the boundaries of AI, we are looking for passionate individuals to work with us on some of the most interesting and challenging AI questions of our time. Our vision is bold and broad: to build systems with true artificial intelligence across agents, applications, services, and infrastructure. It is also inclusive: we aim to make AI accessible to consumers, businesses, and developers so that everyone can realize its benefits.<br><br>Microsoft AI (MS AI) is seeking an experienced engineer to help build and operate the evaluation platform that supports large-scale model training and development. We’re looking for someone who combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with operational excellence and who can build reliable evaluation infrastructure at scale. This role will work closely with researchers and training teams across our European offices to ensure evaluations are reliable, efficient, and available when teams need them.<br>We seek a versatile engineer who can build solutions that stand the test of time and who brings positive energy, empathy, and kindness to the team while remaining highly effective in a fast-paced environment.<br><br>Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.<br>This role is based in London, U.K., or Zurich, Switzerland. Candidates are expected to be local to the applicable office and work in the office four days per week.</p> <h3><br>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Serve as a primary engineer for the evaluation platform during European hours, providing dedicated coverage for the evaluation stack supporting large-scale model training.</li> <li>Develop and extend core evaluation platform capabilities, including benchmark configurations, problem sets, graders, and evaluation runners.</li> <li>Improve evaluation throughput and scheduling efficiency.</li> <li>Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and dashboards to proactively detect evaluation degradation.</li> <li>Partner closely with researchers and training teams across European offices to define evaluation requirements, coordinate launches, and unblock experiments.</li> <li>Contribute to technical design and code reviews across the evaluation platform stack, and maintain high-quality operational documentation and on-call runbooks.</li> <li>Embody our culture and values.</li> </ul> <h3><br>Required Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field AND 4+ years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, Python, C++, Go, or Rust;</li> <li>OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field AND 2+ years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, Python, C++, Go, or Rust;</li> <li>OR equivalent experience.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience operating production distributed systems, including participation in a formal on-call rotation.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python, including experience working in a large, shared, typed codebase.</li> <li>Experience debugging distributed system failures across the stack, including scheduling, resource exhaustion, networking, and process-level faults.</li> <li>Willingness and availability to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation covering European business hours.</li> </ul> <h3><br>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with GPU-based workloads, distributed training, or large-scale inference infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience with distributed compute frameworks and schedulers, such as Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable systems.</li> <li>Experience with observability and alerting tooling, such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM evaluation, benchmarking, or reinforcement learning training infrastructure.</li> <li>Track record of reducing operational burden through systematic reliability improvements, automation, or tooling.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing requirements and deadlines.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>The typical base pay range for this role across Switzerland is CHF 183,800.00 - CHF 309,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.</p> <p>Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/switzerland-corporate-pay</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="flex items-start justify-between m:block"> <div class="w-grid24-col-span-12 wysiwyg m:w-full"> <p>Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:<br><a href="https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay">https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay</a></p> <br>This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.</div> <div class="w-grid24-col-span-12 wysiwyg m:w-full"><br>Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about <a href="https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html"><strong><u>requesting accommodations.</u></strong></a></div> </div> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate, Clients, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>4024 - Senior Associate, Clients, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>EssenceMediacom has a vision of world-class communications, and since recently we have been moving to a combined agency model including Media, Creative, PR, Data & CRM agency partners to build a team from the best people in the industry to work in partnership with our clients.  This is a huge opportunity to be part of an industry changing dynamic that makes a genuine difference through communications.</p> <p>Supporting Honda’s UK business across automobiles, motorcycles, marine, and power products, this role works closely with the UK-based European team to provide outstanding client service and best-in-class media planning. You will use agency tools and technology, collaborate with a biddable hub to maximise client value, and develop distinctive local campaigns that keep Honda front of mind in a competitive market.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities of the role:</strong></p> <p>Growing Our Clients’ Businesses</p> <ul> <li>Build a strong relationship with your clients and become a trusted partner.</li> <li>Develop a solid understanding of your client’s business, marketing, and the role media plays.</li> <li>Work with your SAD and AM to create a ‘Great Work Manifesto’ for your clients</li> <li>Be a confident communications planner who demonstrates a clear understanding of our DPAM (Discover Plan Activate Measure) and The Open Intelligence System (our proprietary Planning tool).</li> <li>Develop an understanding of digital, data, and marketing technology, and how we use them to drive growth for our clients</li> <li>Be the go-to expert in your team for audience and category insight, ensuring all work we develop is evidence based.</li> <li>Actively participate in ‘Acceleration’ and ‘Stretch’ sessions on your clients, and those within your business group.</li> <li>Ensure we have a seamless working process between the Comms & Implementation Planning. </li> </ul> <p>Growing Our Business</p> <ul> <li>Build a clear understanding of EssenceMediacom’s functions and how each specialist area can drive growth for your clients. </li> <li>Support your Director, SAD, and AM in identifying and pursuing additional services opportunities on your clients.</li> <li>Ensure your accounts are in perfect financial health.</li> <li>Play an active role in new business pitches (behind the scenes).</li> </ul> <p>Growing Our People</p> <ul> <li>Promote your team’s brilliant work, both within EssenceMediacom and beyond.</li> <li>Actively participate in and contribute to agency wide planning initiatives (e.g. Huddles). </li> </ul> <p>Growing Yourself</p> <ul> <li>Learn one new skill each year that is actively applied to your client’s business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail</li> <li>Understanding of the principles of marketing and advertising, as well as an understanding of media concepts and terms, creative and budget requirements</li> <li>Interest in developing media strategy skills as well as experience implementational media delivery</li> <li>Problem solving skills and a desire to find a “better way”</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>The ability to multi-task, prioritise and manage expectations</li> <li>Honesty and integrity</li> <li>Calm under pressure and able to juggle multiple projects</li> <li>You will be enthusiastic, helpful and collaborative, and be seeking an environment where you can learn, develop, and actively contribute to the evolution of a key agency account</li> <li>Ideally you would have been working for at least two years a similar role at another agency</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This person will assume ultimate responsibility for the paid social output of a busy client account (or accounts) and will also help oversee a team of more junior staff responsible for the day-to-day running of the account. Experience managing a team of social specialists, preferably in an agency environment, is crucial to this role. This person will also be required to develop strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders becoming a trusted voice for all things paid social. As such the ideal candidate is someone with extensive knowledge of paid advertising across all the key social channels (Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Snap, TikTok etc).</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Business Directors are charged with overall responsibility for the paid social output of one (or more) client accounts, with several key areas of focus. These include:</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overseeing the production of comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client’s objectives and KPIs. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Overseeing a hybrid team (made up of both local and Global Hub employees) responsible for the end-to-end setup of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms. Comfortable troubleshooting and helping train junior team members to use advanced features such as bid rules and 3<sup>rd</sup> party optimisation/creative/measurement tools.</li> <li>Ultimately responsible for maintaining the standard of regular quality assurance (QA) checks undertaken by everyone working on the account (both locally and in the Global Hub) to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards (and helping to evolve these best-practices as necessary).</li> <li>Working with team to ensure the standard and accuracy of weekly/monthly campaign performance reports. Joining client calls on a regular basis and supporting the team to present results as necessary.</li> <li>Ensuring all performance commentary delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Working with the team to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise/mitigate these trends as necessary.</li> <li>Ensuring the standard of end-of-campaign reporting and quarterly/annual reviews. Leading standalone research projects as required by the client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for delivering on the over-arching paid social strategy across the account(s) and ensuring this ties in with the wider digital and comms strategy.</li> <li>Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency’s social output.</li> <li>Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client’s business. Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Managing internal and external stakeholders to ensure multiple projects can be delivered simultaneously and to the required standard.</li> <li>Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, Twitter, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong>People Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensuring the effective management of both the local team and Global Hub employees, ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored & prioritised to ensure deadlines are met.</li> <li>Working with your immediate team to help train and develop their skills as necessary. Leading by example to motivate and encourage all those with less experience on the wider team.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary.</li> <li>Attend and lead regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community.</li> <li>Leading the recruitment process for your immediate team and working with the head of department to assist with wider team recruitment as needed. This will involve leading interviews, making staffing decisions and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing. Developing these into initiatives that can be used to further evolve the standard & efficiency of paid social buying across the wider team.</li> <li>Developing tailored testing/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform.</li> <li>Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Collaborating on thought-leadership pieces and POVs for the agency and GMS social community.</li> <li>Responsible for the accurate and effective management of agency finance processes. Ensuring the immediate team fulfil the mandatory finance process in a timely and accurate manner to ensure prompt payment/invoicing and minimise finance queries.</li> <li>Working to ensure account profitability with direct input on staffing and commercial target conversations where required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>Experience working in a busy agency or client-side social team is key to this role. We are looking for a candidate who is able to display the following attributes:</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience setting up and optimising paid social campaigns across a number of the key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). Training certifications in any of the key platforms would be a plus (e.g. Meta Blueprint).</li> <li>Experience planning large-scale paid social campaigns, preferably across a mix of brand and direct-response objectives.</li> <li>Experience compiling detailed and insightful end of campaign reports & presentations. Experience managing a team to jointly compile regular client presentations (QBRs, annual reviews etc).</li> <li>A clear a track record of working with clients and external stakeholders. Forming strong relationships is key to the role and the ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting to clients and leading calls on a regular basis.</li> <li>Experience line managing others, helping ensure day-to-day workloads are effectively managed. structures.</li> <li>Balances bold creative thinking with a sharp commercial eye, making sure every campaign maximises client investment and drives meaningful business impact.</li> </ul> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilise the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in digital PR Your key function is to scale executive attention, accelerate decision velocity, and translate GSO’s highest strategic priorities into clear execution and follow-through.</p> <p>The ideal Chief of Staff operates with high EQ to maintain Reddit’s open, collaborative, and accessible culture while ensuring that executive time is prioritized for high-impact drivers. You will partner closely with Sales Strategy & Operations, regional sales leadership, and cross-functional executive teams to orchestrate a seamless operational rhythm and drive global alignment.</p> Sales Strategy & Operations:</strong> Partner seamlessly with Sales Strategy & Operations by translating strategic outputs into operational workstreams, leadership narratives, and review frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Executive Communications & Collateral:</strong> Drive end-to-end preparation of strategic collateral, executive presentations, board materials, and organizational communications in close coordination with Internal Comms partners.</li> </ul> <li><em>Track Strategic Priorities & Follow-Through</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Track & Report on Key Commercial Marketing, and SS&O. </li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications: </strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant experience in a Sales/revenue/business strategy & operations role within an ad sales description: What we’re all about. Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all. We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us. The opportunity. Quantexa’s largest customer engagements are now enterprise platform transformations, and we want to replicate that success across strategic customers globally. We are establishing a dedicated platform function for the first time, and we are looking for a player-manager to lead it. Reporting to the SVP of Data & AI Platform Solutions, you will build and lead a small, senior, global team of platform architects. You will shape how Quantexa takes its Data & AI and Context Layer propositions to market, and you will personally lead support our most strategic pursuits, supporting large platform deployments from early technical engagement and proof of concept through to value realisation and expansion. Success means more platform deals won, larger and faster-moving pursuits, and customers who expand their use of the platform after go-live. That track record is what will earn the team its growth. The role is greenfield: you will define what the function owns, how it works and how it scales within the context of the wider operating model. What You’ll Be Doing Win strategic platform deals Lead the technical and business narrative on targeted global accounts, working alongside field engineers and sales. Build the demos and integrations that show customers the value. Build and lead the team Set the direction and standards for a global team of platform architects, and coach and develop them. Shape how the team works with Field Engineering and regional account teams, and where it focuses its effort in line with strategic priorities. Create a repeatable platform method Own the methodology and toolkit that take a customer from a first use case to wider platform adoption. Work with the Enablement and Marketing teams to enable partners, customers and colleagues to run platform engagements themselves for self-sufficiency in applying best practice approaches for platform and context layer – contributing content and helping coordinate execution. What you’ll bring? A record of C-suite, business and technical engagement, including running executive workshops. Experience managing and influencing teams of architects and developing senior technical talent. The ability to work with Product and Marketing: you can turn customer needs into clear requirements and explain technical differentiation to a market audience. The agility of a player-manager: you can lead a senior executive meeting in the morning and be hands-on with a design or demo in the afternoon. Broad architecture experience: enterprise architecture, for vision and roadmaps solution architecture, for shaping opportunities data architecture, for designing data products The technical depth to be credible with CTOs, CDOs and Chief Architects on data integration, platform architecture and secure deployment models. title: Product Marketing Lead
description: Product Marketing Lead Reporting to: CMO Location: London (hybrid, 4 days a week in the office) Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + equity About Electric Twin Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We build synthetic audiences: simulations of real groups of people, grounded in research data. Teams ask them questions, test ideas and explore how people might respond, and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks. The work is grounded, and the science is real. We've run over 40,000 evaluations across populations covering 155 countries. Independent academic research with Professor Michael Muthukrishna at the LSE found our outputs come back roughly 10,000x faster than traditional methods, at 95% accuracy. Customers including The Times, Sage, Virgin, Vodafone and Wingstop use Electric Twin to bring customer insight into decisions about campaigns, products, pricing and strategy. Electric Twin was founded by Dr Ben Warner (former Chief Data Advisor to the UK Prime Minister) and our CEO, Alex Cooper (a former senior military commander and Director of Mass Covid Testing in the pandemic). We're backed by Atomico, LocalGlobe, Mercuri and angels including Marc Andreessen. We're a team of engineers, AI researchers, behavioural scientists and operators - careful with the science, careful with the responsibility. The role We're hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing at Electric Twin, from the strategy through to the sales deck. Our ambition is to make understanding people a normal part of making decisions. Product marketing is central to that. It's how we decide who Electric Twin is for, what we compete against and why a buyer should choose us, and how that story reaches the market through our product, our website and our sales team. Next year is a big one. We're launching in new markets, taking Electric Twin to more parts of a business, and bringing more products to market. We need someone who has operated at this level before, and who can join the dots between sales, marketing and product. Product marketing here covers four areas: insights, storytelling, go-to-market and enablement. You'll own all four, and decide where to lean in as the company grows. You'll work closely with our CMO, our VP Product and our sales team. Our Growth Lead runs the engine - the channels and programmes that reach and convert our audience. Product marketing and content provide the fuel. You'll own positioning and messaging. Our Content Lead will turn it into stories and get them out across every channel. This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, and you'll also write the launch plan, the value proposition brief and the sales deck yourself. What’s exciting - you’re the founding PMM and get to build out and lead this function as we expand. What you'll do Insights Be the expert on our customer. We have strong customer research, a map of what customers want to use the product for and a regular round-up of the questions they ask. Build on it, keep it current and make sure the rest of the business uses it. Understand the buyers we're growing into. Our buyer today is the insights team. Marketing, product and commercial teams come next. Speak to them, define who they are and work out what they need to hear from us. Know the market. This is a fast-moving category, with research incumbents launching their own products and a new batch of innovators arriving. Track it, and keep a clear, committed point of view on how Electric Twin is different. Bring an opinion to product strategy. Work with our VP Product on the value proposition, and bring the customer and the market into decisions about what we build. Storytelling Own our positioning and messaging. Keep one consistent way of describing what Electric Twin is, who it is for and why a buyer should choose it, used by sales, product and marketing. Own the trust story. Trust is central to how buyers choose us. Own how we prove it: the evidence, the customer stories and the guidance for prospects who want to evaluate us for themselves. Turn the product into language a buyer would use. Take what we build and describe it in the customer's words, across the website, the product and our sales materials. Shape the story for new markets and buyers. Build and adjust the narrative for our new market launches, and for the teams beyond insight and research that we want to reach. Go-to-market Set the product narrative. Agree a product narrative each quarter with our VP Product, so every launch adds up to a bigger story. Run our launches. Build a tiered launch process so the effort matches the size of the release, and run it with product, sales and marketing. Take Electric Twin to new buyers and markets. Plan how we go to market in the US, in new verticals and with new teams inside our customers. Improve the buyer journey on our website. Work with growth, content and design so the site shows the product and has something for visitors who aren't yet ready to talk to sales. Enablement Equip our sales team. A sales deck built on our positioning, battlecards for the alternatives that come up most, ROI material for the economic buyer and a pack our champions can take to their senior stakeholders. Build a working relationship with sales. Agree priorities together, with one route in for requests and a short brief for each. Train sales and CX. Run onboarding and regular training on our positioning, product, use cases and objection handling, so both teams can explain our value and help customers get the most from Electric Twin. Build feedback loops across teams. Create regular workflows that bring sales objections, win/loss insights and CX feedback into product priorities, positioning and enablement. Take updates back to those teams and check whether they solve the problems raised. Be an advocate inside the business. Present to the company, and represent the customer and the product in the conversations that matter. You need to be the central point between Sales, Marketing and Product and drive the strategy proactively to each - ultimately for the benefit of the customer. Build our product marketing operating system. Bring our research, positioning and messaging into one managed source of truth that feeds the tools used across product, sales, customer success and internal comms. Use AI to build repeatable workflows on top of it and keep it updated. Your first six months Take our positioning and messaging and get it into the website, sales enablement and our core external-facing materials. Agree the first quarterly product narrative with our VP Product, and get a tiered launch process running. Rebuild sales enablement, with battlecards, ROI material and a pack for champions. Define the marketing buyer and build the narrative for our new market launches. Get the product marketing operating system up and running. What we're looking for Experience At least five years in product marketing alone. You've done this role before, ideally growing a product in a similar space or selling to an enterprise audience. You've owned positioning and messaging, and taken it through to a website and sales materials that people used. You've run product launches with a product team, and worked closely with a sales team on what they need to win deals. You've partnered with senior product and commercial leaders, and you're as comfortable having an opinion on product strategy as on sales and commercial strategy. You understand the tools and techniques of the trade, including Jobs-to-be-done and know how to define messaging and positioning. Skills and approach Autonomous. You can own the strategy and ship the copy without much steering. . A good writer, and strong at the content specific to product marketing, such as sales decks and value proposition briefs. A strong communicator. You can present internally and be an advocate for the customer and the product. Curious and proactive. You know what you don't know, you read up or ask for help, and you act on problems once you've spotted them. You've used AI to build repeatable workflows, and you can judge when the output is good enough and when it isn't. You can operate in a fast-paced environment that has ambiguity. You work with a sense of urgency, you raise issues as they arise and you anticipate problems Careful with the details. You're comfortable getting to grips with AI, research and technical subjects, you ask good questions and you check claims carefully. What we offer £80,000-£100,000 base Meaningful equity in a high-potential seed-stage company Unlimited leave. Take the time you need Generous matched pension contributions Private healthcare Cycle to work scheme Ownership of product marketing, with real influence over how the function is built Direct access to and collaboration with world-class founders Hybrid working from our London office (4 days in office a week) Flexible working around life commitments. We value outcomes over presenteeism When you apply, please share examples of your product marketing work, such as positioning, a launch or sales materials, explaining your contribution and what it achieved. title: Staff Software Engineer
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform. What you'll be working on: Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services. Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries. Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles. Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal. Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models. Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production. Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services. Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers. Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment. We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript , with Java and Kotlin as a nice to have. Above all, strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis. This is a 80/20 hands-on technical leadership role , combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams. Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested Your colleagues would say you Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care. Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions. Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution. Coach others and create space for people to grow. Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work Wellbeing days - fully paid days off designed for a slower pace, allowing you to take time to recharge and prioritise self-care We provide access to MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far Access to LinkedIn Learning - acquire new skills, stay abreast of industry trends and fuel your personal and professional development continuously Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms. About the Team We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team , which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling. In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time. You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations . You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans. You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio . What You Will Do Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling. Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams. Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas. Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration. Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment. Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes. Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts. Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact. What You Must Have Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment. Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion. Professional fluency in French , including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French. Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders , and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation. Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities. Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions. Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working. It's a Plus If You Have Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based. Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers. Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software. Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees. Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks. Our Benefits 💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options. 🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours. 🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office. 🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to. 🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work. 📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career. 🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered. 🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being. 🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected. *Final compensation will depend on location, skills, and experience. Spain: For this position in Spain, the On-Target Earnings (OTE) range from €76,000–€120,000 (50/50 base and commission split), with uncapped commission potential. Key responsibilities Site visits and operational assessments Visit customer sites to understand working practices, machine movements, pedestrian interfaces, traffic management, visibility and exclusion zones. Confident communication with site managers, operators, customer HSE teams and deployment personnel. Willingness to travel frequently and work independently in active industrial environments. Desirable Experience with heavy mobile plant, remote operations or automation; familiarity with UK/EU workplace safety requirements and relevant industry qualifications (e.g. NEBOSH or IOSH). title: Principal Data Scientist
description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions. As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted. Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering. Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients. Set the standard for how the data science function works: reproducibility, analysis and code review, experiment design, dataset governance and ground-truth definitions Act as the primary technical reviewer and expert resource across the research organisation, reviewing technical reports, analysis plans and evaluation methodology, and holding the bar for methodological rigour and scientific integrity. Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields. Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents. AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively. Skills & Experience: 15+ years of experience in data science, ML, or applied research, with a strong track record of independent technical leadership on complex, ambiguous problems A career working to extract small signals from noisy, complex physiological systems, and developing and deploying physical models of those systems to support those efforts. Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies. A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product. Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges. Extensive experience owning calibration and cross-instrument comparability work that involved noise models, error budgets, and evaluation of experimental data Strong record of scientific output: publications, patents, or equivalent evidence of original technical contribution and domain authority Nice to Have: Background in neuroscience, neuromonitoring, or cerebrovascular physiology Experience with optical signal processing - e.g. LiDAR, pulse oximetry, NIRS, laser doppler flowmetry, or related technologies Experience in a regulated industry (medical devices, diagnostics, pharma, or similar), with familiarity of algorithm validation and documentation requirements for software as a medical device Benefits: Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company Salary-sacrifice pension scheme Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded) Group life assurance at 4x annual income Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores Access to Udemy for upskilling and professional development Disclaimer - We use Granola, an AI notetaker, throughout our interview process to help capture notes. title: Business Operations Manager
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. The Role The Business Operations Manager works directly with the VP of Seller Operations to define, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives that improve how Motorway operates, grows, and delivers value to our sellers. This is a high-impact, dynamic leadership role focused on solving critical operational and commercial problems across the entire seller journey. You will be responsible for defining and managing the implementation of initiatives that improve the end-to-end seller experience, launching new solutions, and optimising existing processes. You will combine deep analytical thinking with robust program management to drive conversion, improve customer experience, reduce operational costs, and increase automation across the business. The scope of this role is intentionally broad and highly cross-functional. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across operations, product, engineering, finance, marketing, and commercial teams to develop joint plans, align priorities, and execute complex solutions. Motorway moves quickly and operates in a constantly evolving environment. This role suits a strategic operator who thrives in ambiguity, possesses natural commercial curiosity, and excels at taking ownership of messy, complex problems and turning them into structured, scalable solutions. We’re looking for someone who instinctively looks for smarter ways to get things done, whether that is redesigning a process, automating manual work or using AI / Tooling to solve problems. Location: Based in London, with a requirement to travel to our Brighton office once a week. Key Responsibilities Support the definition of long-term improvement plans across Motorway operations, clearly articulating how these initiatives will enhance the overall seller experience. Deep dive into operational, financial, and product data to diagnose problems, build financial models, and uncover both short-term quick wins and long-term strategic opportunities across the seller journey (from enquiry through to post-sale). Lead major new and existing initiatives from concept through to delivery, taking full responsibility for the realisation of business case goals and course-correcting as required. Coordinate and drive delivery across partner teams (including product/tech, marketing, finance, and commercial teams), setting clear KPIs and phased goals to ensure all stakeholders meet their deliverables. Define, prioritise, and track initiatives that drive measurable impact across revenue, CX, and cost, establishing robust tracking frameworks and success metrics. Drive automation and process improvements to reduce manual work. Actively explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI tools, to improve workflows, decision-making, and operational scalability. Simplify highly complex operational problems and translate them into clear, actionable roadmaps and business cases for senior leadership and cross-functional partners. What You’ll Have Experience in business operations, management consulting, or a strategic growth role, with a demonstrable history of taking initiatives from idea to execution. Strong capability in analysing data, building financial models to prioritise opportunities, and translating metrics into strategic decisions. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate, align, and drive accountability across diverse teams like product, marketing, and finance. High levels of ownership, pace, and adaptability. You thrive in fast-changing environments and can structure vague problems into clear execution plans. You actively explore and use AI tools to supercharge how you think, analyse data, and execute work, and you are excited about applying these tools to solve real business problems. A mindset focused on ROI, KPIs, and business case realisation, always balancing operational efficiency with an exceptional seller experience. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. You'll own the full sales cycle—prospecting to close—for enterprise and Global 2000 organisations across the UK and Benelux in financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, and enterprise software. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale. This is a territory with significant scope to build. You'll shape how we cover Benelux, work closely with our partner ecosystem to extend reach, and take Cohere deeper into UK and Northern European enterprise. Pipeline generation sits with you. This is a hunter role for someone who takes pride in building their own book rather than working leads handed to them. This is a highly autonomous role demanding ownership of multi-million-dollar territories. title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Senior Product Engineer Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice . We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. About the Role This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience. Why This Role Stands Out Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before. You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year. AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience. We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones. What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer? Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes. Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key. Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace. Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards. Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production. You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed. What You'll Own Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives. Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability. Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans. Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability. Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback. Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team. Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems. Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly. Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity. Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers. Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems. Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams. Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production. Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required. Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting. Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome. Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem. People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release. Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.</p> <p>At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.</p> <p>Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Ship, measure, learn, repeat. Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable. Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review. Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems. Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why. You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value. You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting. You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them. You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers. CEO.</p> <p>You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.</p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>What You Will Own</strong></p> title: Account Executive, Growth - UK&I
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape. If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta: Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities. Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes. Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals. Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value. Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices. Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter. Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets. Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals. How to be successful in this role: 3+ years closing experience Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?
